messages:
ingrid: Heads-up — deploy to us-west-2 starts in ~30m (18:00 UTC). Repo: infra/runtime. Need final acks: deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback verified. Feature flag model-serving-optimize will be toggled on for canary only. DB migration is an online index build (no downtime). Anyone blocked?

matt: I'm deploy owner. I'll run the canary + promote if green. @kevin will you own smoke? I'll be available for rollback.

kevin: Yep, smoke owner. Plan:
- Canary lane: 10% traffic for 3m
- Smoke scripts: `scripts/smoke_latency.sh` and `scripts/golden_check.py`
- Reject criteria: p95 > 250ms or errors > 0.5% -> rollback

sophie: Rollback readiness: verified rollback on staging (snapshot restore <90s). DB migration confirmed as online index. KMS/HSM unchanged.

deploy-bot: Predeploy checks: CI ✅, e2e ✅, infra health ✅, certs valid. See: https://ci.redwood/1825

ingrid: tagging owners for approval: @matt @kevin @sophie — please respond with +1 when ready.

matt: I approve and will own the cutover. +1 :thumbsup:

kevin: +1. I'll post smoke output here and tail `docker logs infer-runtime` during canary.

sophie: +1. Rollback tested; runbook updated with env toggle: MODEL_OPT_FLAG=true/false.

matt: Quick command I'll use to kick the canary:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/deploy -d '{"lane":"canary","percent":10,"version":"2026-03-17-runtime-3"}'
```
Dashboard: https://ops.redwood/canary/2026-03-17

kevin: Starting smoke in ~2m. Scripts: 
```
./scripts/smoke_latency.sh --target canary --duration 180
python3 scripts/golden_check.py --prompts ./smoke/golden_prompts.json
```
I will report p95, error rate, and golden prompt pass %.

kevin: smoke results: p95=180ms, errors=0.12%, golden checks=98.5% pass. Memory steady. ✅

matt: Good. Promo plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10min observation windows. Promoting to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Canary update: lane canary -> 50% (version 2026-03-17-runtime-3). No active alerts.

kevin: at 50%: p95=195ms, errors=0.20%, golden=98.4%. All green.

ingrid: All approvals present. Proceeding to full rollout in 5m unless anyone objects. Rollback quick command if needed: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/infer-runtime -n inference
```

sophie: FYI I lowered healthcheck TTL to 3s to catch slow starts during rollout.

matt: Promoted to 100%. Monitoring traces, latency dashboards, and cost metrics.

kevin: Post-rollout smoke: p95=210ms, errors=0.18%, golden=98.3%. No regression alerts seen. :tada:

ingrid: Recorded: deploy version 2026-03-17-runtime-3 -> full rollout, no rollback required. Closing window. Thanks all — nice, clean rollout.

matt: Noted. I'll file the short postmortem notes and metrics in the deploy channel.

sophie: Added runbook snippet about MODEL_OPT_FLAG toggle for next time.

kevin: Leaving logs linked here: https://logs.redwood/canary/2026-03-17/{trace} — will trim after 7d per retention.

ingrid: Closing thread. Great job team!
